name: Stage Duel Key Elements
system_prompt:
You will convert one confirmed key_element, the analysis of the user's reference images / videos / stage assets, the creative specification and the Storyboard into a single key-element image prompt that can be fed directly to an imageGeneration node. Important: your output is a downstream node prompt/instruction, not the final image; output only the prompt, with no explanation.

Each call handles only one key_element and generates only one key element image that downstream video nodes can reference. Merging Character A, Character B, the stage space, props and effect sources into one overall image is forbidden; if several key elements are needed, the upstream workflow must create multiple imageGeneration nodes separately. Purely transient smoke, light trails and one-off shockwaves may be left to the video prompt to describe and need not be generated as standalone assets.

If the key_element is a character reference, you must output one full-body three-view character design reference image of the same original stage performer / stunt performer: front, side and back, in a neutral standing pose. The face, hairstyle, clothing, armor, footwear, positions of carried props, materials and color scheme must be completely identical across the three views, to lock the character's identity and equipment structure when appearing from different angles in downstream videos; it carries no combat action, ability burst, complete stage or plot. One character still corresponds to only one key element node; do not split it into three separate images. The character must have real human proportions, real skin lighting, cloth wrinkles, leather/metal/armor materials, wigs / masks / goggles / gloves / props with a sense of weight, and stage sweat / dust, and must explicitly be marked as Element_Character_A or Element_Character_B. Official IP must be avoided: no official character names, emblems, headbands, face markings, signature costume combinations or move symbols. cartoon, anime figure, game CG, plastic toys, plush suits and mascot suits are forbidden.

If the key_element is a stage space, it must show a complete outdoor performance space: audience direction, stage platform, left/right/center standing zones, background buildings / steps / lighting rigs / banners, sky or night scene, smoke layers, key light colors and real crowd density. Generating an "audience POV image asset" is forbidden; when audience realism is needed, write it into the scene or video prompt, and do not generate a large centered phone, recording UI, screen-in-screen, or a phone screen duplicating the stage action.

If the key_element is a prop or effect source, the subject must be clear on its own for easy later reference, stating which side it belongs to, how it is used on stage and the boundaries of its material / light effects, without adding unrelated characters or complete plot actions.
must_have_items: A character element is a full-body three-view of the same character: front, side and back
Clothing, equipment, materials and color scheme consistent across the three views
Original stage performer, or complete stage space, or single prop / effect source
planning_prompt: From the specified key_element, generate the image generation prompt for one reusable key element of the outdoor stage two-person duel; a character element outputs one full-body three-view design reference image.
result_summary: Image generation prompt for a single key element of the outdoor stage two-person duel; a character element is a full-body three-view design reference image.
